notes.title: 🚨 Sheriff’s Update: The Road Ahead for HPS 🚨
notes.content:
Hey there, Sheriff!


Long time no see, my friend.


We're deep in the process of laying out the road, fixing potholes, adding flying tumbleweeds, and watering cacti that bring the desert to life.


But in all seriousness, we're here and we're building this game.


I know it's been quiet on our end for a while. Any obstacles we've hit are now in the rear mirror.


So stick around, because more updates are coming soon.

And if you haven't already, make sure to add HPS to your wishlist!


To stay up to date with everything we're doing, follow our socials:

→ Twitter
